note: Small (17.5-acre) Fayette County Conservation park at the confluence of the south and west branches of the shallow Volga River, 3 mi north of Maynard; the river divides it into two sides. Drive-in camping is on the south side (campground side 911 address 14650 130th Street): a few electric sites plus primitive sites in an open mowed grassy area (fits a 23-ft rig on grass), with a shelter house and playground; a short trail goes down to the river. --Claude
summary: Fayette CCB page: 'several electric and primitive campsites', $15 electric / $10 primitive, pit toilets - fees and toilets confirmed. No page states a site count, a booking method or a campground season (mycountyparks 'Open year round' is park hours). MyCountyParks lists no bookable facility. Not waterfront kept; the stored pin is on the north side, ~440 m from the likely camp area.
flags: PIN: stored 42.81835,-91.88435 is the north-side entrance off O Avenue (the Google Maps pin, 13112 O Ave), in a field beside O Ave. MyCountyParks puts the campground/shelter/playground side at 14650 130th Street, and the electric camping 'on the south side'. Imagery shows a gravel lane from 130th Street crossing the south branch on a small bridge to a gravel turnaround in open mowed grass at ~42.8178,-91.8790, ~440 m east of the pin; that is very likely the camp area, but no county map confirms which pads are the sites. Re-pin to ~42.8178,-91.8790 if accepted.

WATERFRONT: not waterfront kept, with doubt on the site location. At the likely camp area the main channel is ~15-20 m wide (creek size) and runs ~25-30 m north of the turnaround behind a continuous band of bank trees; the county says 'A short trail goes down to the river'. No open apron from a site to the water is visible, so creekside is not earned.

BOOKING/SEASON: no Fayette County page states first-come or reservations for this park, and MyCountyParks has no bookable campsite listing, so booking was left unset.
